川西 (1).jpg.zh: 向阳绿坡层层起伏，灰白岩峰耸立于蓝天白云之下
川西 (1).jpg.en: Sunlit green ridges roll toward grey rocky peaks under a blue sky with white clouds.

川西 (2).jpg.zh: 云影掠过灰岩峰群，草甸在斜光里起伏成明暗绿浪
川西 (2).jpg.en: Cloud shadows sweep across grey rocky peaks above rolling green alpine meadows.

川西 (3).jpg.zh: 暖雾弥漫的林间，树影与低矮木棚沉入朦胧日光
川西 (3).jpg.en: Trees and a low shed dissolving into warm, hazy morning light

川西 (4).jpg.zh: 雨后朽木裂纹间的星状苔藓与黄绿地衣，背景虚作青绿。
川西 (4).jpg.en: Star-shaped moss and yellow-green lichen in the cracks of weathered wood, the background blurred to green.

川西 (5).jpg.zh: 浓雾中，一头棕白花牛站在开满黄色野花的草甸上。
川西 (5).jpg.en: A brown-and-white cow stands in a foggy meadow dotted with yellow wildflowers.

川西 (6).jpg.zh: 黑牦牛立于带孔石墙前，远处高原城镇与青山白云相映
川西 (6).jpg.en: A black yak stands by a pierced stone wall, with a highland town and mountains beyond

川西 (7).jpg.zh: 仰拍蓝天白云下，五彩经幡自高杆向四周放射展开
川西 (7).jpg.en: Colorful Tibetan prayer flags radiate from a tall pole against a blue, cloudy sky.

川西.jpg.zh: 长曝光让山涧跌水化成白纱，赭色岩块与秋叶夹岸
川西.jpg.en: Long exposure turns the mountain stream into silk over ochre boulders and autumn leaves.

大连 (1).jpg.zh: 暮色逆光下的城市街口，电车轨道与架空线纵横，车流缓行
大连 (1).jpg.en: Backlit at dusk, tram tracks and overhead wires crisscross a downtown intersection as traffic flows.

大连 (2).jpg.zh: 蓝调夜色下的密集高层住宅群，橙黄街灯与车流照亮纵横街道
大连 (2).jpg.en: Blue-hour sky over dense high-rises, amber streetlights and glowing traffic lighting up the streets

大连 (3).jpg.zh: 晴日海边，金色芦苇丛前矗立着褐色巨岩
大连 (3).jpg.en: Golden reeds before a brown rock outcrop by the sea under a sunny sky

大连 (4).jpg.zh: 四只海鸥掠过无云晴空，正午强光下白翼舒展，羽缘泛金。
大连 (4).jpg.en: Four seagulls glide through a cloudless noon sky, wings spread in bright sunlight.

大连 (5).jpg.zh: 褐黄色岩柱矗立在龟裂的冰面上，晴空下冰湖泛蓝。
大连 (5).jpg.en: A tawny rock pillar rises from cracked ice on a vast frozen lake under clear skies.

大连 (6).jpg.zh: 暮色渐变，海鸥剪影掠过城市天际线，岸边人群驻足仰望
大连 (6).jpg.en: At dusk, gull silhouettes glide past the city skyline as crowds watch from the shore.

大连 (8).JPG.zh: 逆光中的玻璃幕墙高楼与公交车，夕照铺满城市街道
大连 (8).JPG.en: Backlit glass towers and a city bus under low evening sunlight on an urban street

大连 (9).JPG.zh: 冬日枯林前，一头长角公鹿立于斑驳树影中
大连 (9).JPG.en: A long-antlered stag stands in dappled winter light before bare woods

杭州.jpg.zh: 蓝天白云下，绿树环抱的湖面，亭桥与青山倒映水中
杭州.jpg.en: Under a blue sky, a pavilion bridge and green hills reflect in the calm lake

花果山 (1).jpg.zh: 晴空下，雪凇压满高大云杉，两名游客在树下驻足仰望
花果山 (1).jpg.en: Under a clear blue sky, two visitors pause beneath a tall, snow-laden spruce.

花果山 (2).jpg.zh: 晴空下，雾凇覆满松枝，霜白与深蓝相映。
花果山 (2).jpg.en: Rime-coated pine branches against a clear, deep blue winter sky.

花果山.jpg.zh: 逆光下霜花裹满松枝，湛蓝天空映衬暖粉雾凇
花果山.jpg.en: Backlit rime frost coats pine branches against a clear blue winter sky

九寨沟 (2).jpg.zh: 冬日晴光下，枯枝覆霜，沉木横卧碧绿湖水，倒影清晰如镜。
九寨沟 (2).jpg.en: In winter sunlight, frosted branches and sunken logs lie in clear turquoise water, mirrored like glass.

九寨沟 (7).jpg.zh: 正午柔光里，橘白猫蜷在编织垫上闭眼小憩，背景虚成暖红。
九寨沟 (7).jpg.en: In soft midday light, an orange-and-white cat dozes on a woven mat, eyes shut.

九寨沟.jpg.zh: 木栏杆外，深蓝湖面泛着细密波纹，橙色救生圈斜挂栏边。
九寨沟.jpg.en: Beyond the wooden railing, an orange life ring hangs over the deep blue rippled lake.

喀纳斯 (1).jpg.zh: 阴天下碧绿的冰川河穿过针叶林，左岸停着红色漂流艇
喀纳斯 (1).jpg.en: Under overcast skies, a turquoise glacial river runs between spruce forests, red rafts moored on the left bank.

喀纳斯 (2).jpg.zh: 晨雾漫过针叶林，湖面泛白，草甸延伸至远山脚下
喀纳斯 (2).jpg.en: Morning mist drifts over the conifer forest and pale lake, meadow stretching toward distant ridges.

连岛.jpg.zh: 退潮的宽阔沙滩，黄色两栖车静浮浅水，天海一色淡蓝
连岛.jpg.en: At low tide, yellow amphibious vehicles float in the shallows of a wide pale beach.

连云港.jpg.zh: 暮色下海面平静如镜，地平线橙红霞光，礁石化为黑色剪影。
连云港.jpg.en: Dusk over a glassy sea, an orange glow along the horizon, rocks in black silhouette.

七彩丹霞.jpg.zh: 晴空下，彩色格纹热气球喷出火焰缓缓升空
七彩丹霞.jpg.en: A colorful checkered hot air balloon fires its burner against a clear blue sky.

青岛 (1).jpg.zh: 落日沉入灰蓝海平线，载客渡轮驶过，橘红波光铺满海面。
青岛 (1).jpg.en: The sun sinks into the hazy horizon as a passenger ferry glides across the orange-lit sea.

青岛.jpg.zh: 蓝调时分，红白灯塔亮着红灯，立在防波堤尽头，天际泛紫。
青岛.jpg.en: At blue hour, a red-and-white lighthouse glows at the breakwater's end beneath a violet-tinged sky.

青海 (2).jpg.zh: 枯黄草甸、红顶小屋与横贯湖面的电线，上方是堆叠的白云
青海 (2).jpg.en: Dry golden grassland, a small red-roofed hut, power lines across the blue lake under towering cumulus clouds.

青海.jpg.zh: 砾石戈壁滩上两台风机伫立，远处山脊在灰白天空下起伏
青海.jpg.en: Two wind turbines stand on a gravel desert plain, distant ridges under a pale sky.

青海湖 (1).jpg.zh: 蓝天白云下，白色藏式佛塔的金顶、浮雕与基座狮像清晰可见
青海湖 (1).jpg.en: White Tibetan stupa with gilded spire and lion figures under a blue, cloud-streaked sky

青海湖 (2).jpg.zh: 晴日碧水，游船泊岸，浅滩上成群海鸥与枯黄水草相伴
青海湖 (2).jpg.en: White tour boats dock under a clear sky as gulls gather on the grassy shore.

四姑娘山 (1).jpg.zh: 雪线之上，嶙峋山脊被阳光照亮，山脚压着深色针叶林
四姑娘山 (1).jpg.en: Sunlit snow ridges rise above a dark conifer forest under a wispy cirrus sky.

四姑娘山 (2).jpg.zh: 雪峰夹峙的谷底，枯黄草甸上散落着细小的人影与云影。
四姑娘山 (2).jpg.en: Snow peaks flank a valley where tiny figures cross the tawny alpine meadow.

四姑娘山.jpg.zh: 针叶林框出的雪峰，薄云掠过湛蓝天际
四姑娘山.jpg.en: Snow peaks framed by conifer forest beneath a clear blue sky with wispy clouds

苏州 (1).jpg.zh: 夜色中的苏州东方之门，湖面停泊着帆船与游艇。
苏州 (1).jpg.en: Night falls on Suzhou's Gate of the Orient, sailboats moored along the lake.

苏州 (2).jpg.zh: 逆光下的红色枫叶，叶脉透亮，背景绿林虚化成片片光斑
苏州 (2).jpg.en: Backlit red maple leaves glowing against a blurred green woodland bokeh

苏州 (3).jpg.zh: 青石板巷，白墙开六角窗，黄衣人独行，墙头绿树成荫。
苏州 (3).jpg.en: A stone alley with hexagonal windows on whitewashed walls, a lone figure in yellow beneath green trees.

苏州 (4).jpg.zh: 阴天，白墙黛瓦临河而立，黄绿树冠与屋影倒映水面
苏州 (4).jpg.en: Overcast Jiangnan water town: white walls, dark tiles, and a yellow-green canopy mirrored in the canal.

武汉 (1).jpg.zh: 黄鹤楼金瓦飞檐，与玻璃摩天楼在晴空下同框
武汉 (1).jpg.en: Yellow Crane Tower's golden eaves stand before glass skyscrapers under a clear blue sky.

新疆 (1).jpg.zh: 黄昏粉霞下，木制观景塔矗立盐湖畔，一只海鸥掠过。
新疆 (1).jpg.en: At dusk, a wooden viewing tower stands over a pink salt lake as a gull glides past.

新疆 (1).png.zh: 暮色里盐沼泛着粉红，木制观景塔与低飞的鸟倒映在浅水中
新疆 (1).png.en: At dusk, a wooden observation tower and a low-flying bird mirror in the pink-tinged salt marsh.

新疆 (2).jpg.zh: 低角度夕阳照亮辫状河谷，杨树丛与草坡之间停着几辆车
新疆 (2).jpg.en: Low sun lights a braided river valley, cars parked between groves and grassy slopes

新疆 (3).jpg.zh: 暮色中紫红云层压过居民楼剪影，通信塔与铁栅栏静立
新疆 (3).jpg.en: Purple dusk clouds glow crimson above silhouetted apartment blocks and a telecom tower

新疆 (4).jpg.zh: 白云下针叶林密覆山坡，绿草地上牛群低头吃草
新疆 (4).jpg.en: Cattle graze on a green meadow below a densely forested mountain slope under a cloudy blue sky.

新疆 (5).jpg.zh: 阴云低垂，背包客独自沿弯道公路走向远方群山
新疆 (5).jpg.en: Under low clouds, a backpacker walks a curving road toward distant mountains.

新疆 (6).jpg.zh: 辫状河穿行干旱峡谷，蓝天积云下陡崖对峙
新疆 (6).jpg.en: A braided river winds through arid canyon walls beneath a cloud-streaked blue sky.

新疆.jpg.zh: 溪水漫过卵石滩，阳光在水面折出细碎彩色光斑
新疆.jpg.en: Sunlight refracts into small rainbow flares across a shallow stream flowing over pebbles

新疆赛里木湖 (1).jpg.zh: 晴日蓝天下，红衣女子走过石滩，红白灯塔与远山静立湖畔
新疆赛里木湖 (1).jpg.en: Under a clear blue sky, a woman in red walks the rocky shore past a red-and-white beacon tower

新疆赛里木湖 (2).jpg.zh: 浅水倒映云影，绿苇接金黄草甸，远处雪山浮在云层下。
新疆赛里木湖 (2).jpg.en: Shallow water mirrors clouds; green reeds meet golden grass, snow peaks beneath cloud.

新疆赛里木湖 (3).jpg.zh: 蓝调时分，银色SUV停驻红道湖畔，远山横亘于静水之上
新疆赛里木湖 (3).jpg.en: A silver SUV parked on a lakeside road at blue hour, mountains beyond calm water

新疆赛里木湖 (4).jpg.zh: 晴空积云下，深蓝湖面一直铺到远山，水平线近乎静止
新疆赛里木湖 (4).jpg.en: Under a clear sky with cumulus clouds, the deep blue lake stretches flat to distant mountains.

新疆赛里木湖 (6).jpg.zh: 深蓝湖水与金黄草原相接，公路沿湖岸延伸，远处荒山积云
新疆赛里木湖 (6).jpg.en: Deep blue water meets golden steppe, a highway hugging the shore toward distant mountains.

新疆赛里木湖 (7).jpg.zh: 阴云下，红肩公路穿过草原直抵湖畔，两辆车行驶其间
新疆赛里木湖 (7).jpg.en: Under heavy clouds, a red-shouldered road cuts across the grassland toward the lake.

新疆赛里木湖.png.zh: 湖面波光闪烁，三艘游船分列而行，远处山脉横亘于晴空之下。
新疆赛里木湖.png.en: Three boats cruise a glittering blue lake beneath distant mountains and a cloudy sky.

云南 (2).jpg.zh: 阴天下文庙飞檐特写，深色木构与檐下红灯笼
云南 (2).jpg.en: Close-up of a Confucian temple's upturned eaves under an overcast sky, dark timber and a red lantern.

云南.jpg.zh: 深蓝孔雀侧首立于虚化的粉笔菜单牌前，暖光勾出挺立的羽冠
云南.jpg.en: A blue peafowl in profile before a blurred chalkboard menu, warm light on its crest

扎尕那.jpg.zh: 阴云笼罩下，嶙峋石峰环抱梯田与半山寺院村落
扎尕那.jpg.en: Under overcast skies, jagged peaks encircle terraced fields and a hillside monastery village

中卫 (1).jpg.zh: 逆光沙丘波纹层叠，丘顶一人影，晴空悬着新月与两面旗
中卫 (1).jpg.en: Rippled sand dune in low light, a lone figure on the crest under a crescent moon

大连 (7).jpg.zh: 暮色中，玻璃幕墙高楼群与广场上的散步行人
大连 (7).jpg.en: Glass skyscrapers and scattered pedestrians in a vast plaza at dusk.

大连.BMP.zh: 落日把城市天际线与跨海大桥染成剪影，海鸥掠过橙红天空。
大连.BMP.en: Sunset silhouettes the city skyline and sea bridge as gulls cross the orange sky.

大连.jpg.zh: 橙红晚霞下，长桥与城市剪影横亘水面，飞鸟掠过天际。
大连.jpg.en: Under an orange sunset, a long bridge and city skyline silhouette span the water as birds fly.

稻城亚丁 (1).jpg.zh: 金顶藏寺隐于针叶林间，背后雪峰与流云直插蓝天
稻城亚丁 (1).jpg.en: A golden-roofed Tibetan temple tucked among conifers, snow peaks and clouds against blue sky.

稻城亚丁 (2).jpg.zh: 橙颊斑纹小鸟立于枯枝，背景绿林虚化成一片柔光
稻城亚丁 (2).jpg.en: A rufous-cheeked, streaked bird perches on a bare branch against blurred green foliage.

稻城亚丁 (3).jpg.zh: 红嘴红脚的黑鸦立于木桩，身后是虚化的青山与草甸
稻城亚丁 (3).jpg.en: A red-billed chough perches on a wooden post, green hills blurred behind

稻城亚丁 (4).jpg.zh: 黑岩层理间积雪未消，蓝天云影掠过山脊
稻城亚丁 (4).jpg.en: Snow lingers in the dark rock strata as clouds drift past the ridge.

稻城亚丁.jpg.zh: 长曝光柔化瀑布水帘，冷杉枝影横斜于深色岩壁前
稻城亚丁.jpg.en: Long exposure silks the cascade, framed by dark conifer branches against wet rock.

哈尔滨 (2).jpg.zh: 粉墙白拱间，圆形彩窗透光，金色天使像静守白色长椅。
哈尔滨 (2).jpg.en: Pink walls and white arches frame a round stained-glass window glowing above golden angels and white pews.

哈尔滨.jpg.zh: 蓝天白云下，红砖教堂的绿色穹顶与金色十字架格外醒目
哈尔滨.jpg.en: Green onion domes and golden crosses of a red-brick church against blue sky and white clouds.

哈尔滨圣索菲亚教堂.jpg.zh: 仰拍蓝顶旧教堂，金色放射状吊灯居中，顶面漆皮剥落。
哈尔滨圣索菲亚教堂.jpg.en: Looking up at a gold sunburst chandelier centered on a peeling blue church ceiling.

杭州 (1).jpg.zh: 逆光下悬垂的青枫叶，背景虚化成庭园水石与浅淡天光
杭州 (1).jpg.en: Backlit green maple leaves hang against a softly blurred garden pond.

杭州 (2).jpg.zh: 烈日下荷塘铺满绿叶，两朵粉荷盛开，一支花苞待放
杭州 (2).jpg.en: Under harsh midday sun, two pink lotus blooms open among dense green leaves

杭州 (3).jpg.zh: 暖光打在铜色佛像上，幽蓝石窟内错落环绕着群像。
杭州 (3).jpg.en: Warm light illuminates the bronze Buddha, surrounded by smaller statues in a dim blue grotto.

九寨沟 (1).jpg.zh: 冬季瀑布从苔藓岩壁层叠泻下，长曝光成雾，岸边结着冰凌。
九寨沟 (1).jpg.en: Long exposure turns winter cascades into silk over mossy rocks, fringed with ice.

青岛 (6).jpg.zh: 夜幕下的海湾广场，人群隔水拍摄红色雕塑与霓虹高楼
青岛 (6).jpg.en: At night, crowds photograph a red sculpture and neon-lit towers across the bay.

武汉.jpg.zh: 阴天，红色SS9机车牵引绿皮车驶过碎石道床
武汉.jpg.en: Under an overcast sky, a red SS9 locomotive hauls green carriages along gravel tracks.

新疆赛里木湖 (5).jpg.zh: 晴日湖畔，女子举气球站红色跑道上，黑车停于草甸蓝水间
新疆赛里木湖 (5).jpg.en: On a sunny lakeside, a woman with balloons stands on the red path beside a black SUV.

云南 (1).jpg.zh: 阴天柔光下，古戏台木构飞檐，彩绘斗拱间嵌圆形花窗与红联。
云南 (1).jpg.en: Overcast light on an old wooden opera stage with upturned eaves, painted brackets and a round lattice window.

中卫 (2).jpg.zh: 沙脊上一串脚印，银河横贯夜空，地平线泛着橙红灯光
中卫 (2).jpg.en: Footprints along a dune ridge under the Milky Way, city glow on the horizon
